editcheck-dialog-addref-description: Nufashe abasomyi gutahura aho ivyo bintu vyavuye mu kwongera amajambo yo mu gisomwa.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-descripti: Abandi basohora ibitabo boshima kumenya vyinshi ku bijanye n’ingingo yawe yo kudashiramwo amajambo.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-irrelevan: Sinzi ko ibivugwa bifitaniye isano n'ihinduka ndiko ndagira
editcheck-copyvio-description: Turagusavye wirinde kugarukana kandi ivyanditswe bivuye muzindi nkomoko, naho vyoba vyasubiwemwo canke vyavuzwe. Ivyo bishobora gufatwa nk'uguhonyanga uburenganzira bw'umwanditsi canke kwiba kandi bishobora gutuma ibirimwo bikurwaho canke konti yawe igahagarara.
editcheck-copyvio-keep-description: Turagusavye ufashe abandi banditsi b’iki kiganiro gutahura imvo yawe yo kuguma ufise icanditswe cashizweko.
editcheck-copyvio-keep-wrote: Ni jewe nanditse ivyo bintu kandi nta handi vyagiye birasohoka
editcheck-copyvio-keep-other: Nta kintu na kimwe muri ibi bikurikira gifise agaciro
editcheck-copyvio-keep-notify: Urakoze cane kuba warasiguye igituma utashaka ko ico canditswe gisomwa!
editcheck-double-bold-title: Kureko uburyo bwo guhindura mu buryo butari bwo
editcheck-double-bold-description: Indome zikomeye zikoreshwa ubwazo ku mitwe mitomito, amajambo y'urutonde rw'insobanuro n'imitwe y'imbonerahamwe. Fasha abasomyi mu gukuraho [{{int:editcheck-kabiri-gushiramwo-insobanuro}} uburyo butari ngombwa] muri ivyo bintu.
editcheck-tone-description: Abandi bakunze guhindura bene aya majambo, bavuga ko yegamye uruhande rumwe.  [{{int:editcheck-tone-descriptionlink}} Menya vyinshi]
editcheck-tone-description-acted: Raba amajambo atera isoni, asuzugura, adasobanutse neza, ateye isoni canke ashigikira iciyumviro kinaka.
editcheck-tone-thank: Murakoze cane kuba mwaritwararitse ukuntu tuvuga!
editcheck-yearlink-description: Iyo nsiguro yerekana umwaka utandukanye n'uwo mu gisomwa. Nufashe kugira ico kiganiro kirushirize kuba ciza mu kurondera umwaka uhuye n'uwo musi.
editcheck-external-link-description: Iyi nzira yerekana [{{int:editcheck-inyuma-ihuriro-insobanuro}} urubuga rw'inyuma]. Fasha abasomyi kuguma bitwararika ibirimwo mu gukuraho iri huriro, ukarijana mu gice ca “Ihuza ryo hanze”, canke ukarihindura [{{int:editcheck-external-link-convertlink}} citation] nimba bibereye.
editcheck-duplicate-link-description: Iryo huriro riboneka incuro zirenga imwe muri iki gice. Fasha abasomyi kugendagenda mu buryo bworoshe mu gukuraho [{{int:editcheck-isubiriza-ihuriro-ihuriro ry'insobanuro}} amahuza asubiramwo].
editcheck-disambiguation-description: Iyi nzira yerekana [{{int:editcheck-ugusobanura-insobanuro}} urupapuro rwo gusobanura]. Fasha abasomyi kuronka iciyumviro kibereye mu guhuza kuri paji yihariye.
editcheck-headinglevel-description: Uwo murongo w’umutwe ushobora kudakurikira urutonde rwiza. Fasha abasomyi kugendagenda mu buryo bworoshe ukoresheje [{{int:editcheck-urugero rw'umutwe-insobanuro}} urugero rw'umutwe].
editcheck-image-caption-description: Iyi shusho nta nkuru ifise. Fasha abasomyi gutahura igituma ishusho ifise akamaro mu kwongerako [{{int:editcheck-ishusho-insobanuro-insobanuro}} insobanuro ngufi].
editcheck-convertreference-description: Iyi nkuru irabura ido n’ido. Fasha abasomyi gutahura aho amakuru ava mu guhindura aya mu buryo buteye [{{int:editcheck-guhindura-insobanuro}} inyandiko]. Uhejeje kuyihindura, nusuzume ko amakuru ico gikoresho congereyeko ari ukuri, hanyuma ukureho ikintu cose kitari co canke kigutera urujijo.
editcheck-reject-description: Abandi bahinduzi boshima kumenya igituma wahisemwo ivyo.
editcheck-specialeditchecks-disabled: Guhindura amasuzumo ntibishoboka kuri iyi wiki.
